messages:
rita: quick postmortem note: after enabling wider preflight sampling we saw a 2.6x token multiplier for a few tenants around 01:10 UTC. heatmap flagged ingress traffic.
derek: which flag? sampler.rate?
rita: yes, telemetry.preflight.sample_rate 0.4% -> 3% last night. intended to capture rare dim combos.
qing: expected side-effect: more preflights -> more detected mixed-dim batches -> splitter multiplies internal RPCs.
pm-lucy: CS wants a short customer-friendly explanation and mitigation.
rita: immediate mitigation: revert trial/sandbox to 0.5% and keep prod on the canary. I've queued it.
ops-bot: config toggle applied (job id: 22110). monitoring window active.
ops-bot: post-change snapshot: splitter_invocations down ~57% for impacted tenants; cost delta reduced ~40% vs peak.
derek: long-term we should avoid sampling causing multiplier side-effects. proposal: an ingress-side cheap "preflight estimator" API that predicts split probability and est_units without invoking the splitter.
qing: agree. estimator should be O(1), p95 < 5ms, and conservative by default (bias to overpredict split). sketch below:
```
POST /v1/embeddings/preflight/estimate
{
  "num_inputs": 64,
  "avg_input_bytes": 900,
  "dims_hint": [512]
}

200 OK
{
  "est_units": 1200,
  "prob_split": 0.73,
  "est_confidence": 0.82,
  "recommended_action": "reduce_batch_to_16"
}
```
rita: console UX: show "estimated units" in the quick-run preview and a yellow "may fragment" badge when prob_split > 0.5. PM-lucy wants a billing banner during canary so finance isn't surprised.
pm-lucy: yes, please add that banner + customer note template.
derek: operational concern: if ingress calls estimator per request we add fanout. mitigation: LRU cache keyed by payload hash + per-instance QPS cap for estimator calls. cache TTL tiny (10s) to avoid stale hints.
qing: also add a header X-Estimator-Id on requests when estimator was consulted so splitter logs/traces can correlate prediction->actual. telemetry: sample predictions at 1% to compute accuracy; expected storage +~10%. I'll file obs ticket.
ops-bot: created alert rule: embed.splitter_amplification > 2.0 within 120m of telemetry.preflight.sample_rate change (id: R-7762). will auto-revert if triggered per runbook.
derek: rollout plan: canary ingress-auto-estimator in us-west for 25k requests. success criteria: estimator_precision >= 0.9, estimator_p95 < 5ms, console_preview vs actual billed units divergence < 5%.
rita: add a console badge "preview authoritative" when ingress used estimator for routing; otherwise show "preview may differ" to reduce CS confusion.
qing: runtime: minor change to accept X-Estimator-Id and log it. also make bias configurable per-tenant for enterprise customers who prefer safety.
pm-lucy: product asks: include a recommended action string in estimator so client libs can suggest automatic re-batching. good DX.
derek: I'll draft API PR + microbench harness. will include LRU cache design and rate-limit knobs.
rita: q for security: ensure estimator respects tenant scoping and doesn't leak stats cross-tenant. audit logs required.
ops-bot: noted. feature-flag job f-4422 created to gate ingress-auto-estimator.
pm-lucy: follow-ups: DEREK -> API PR & perf bench; QING -> obs ticket + telemetry schema; RITA -> customer note + runbook updates; OPS-BOT -> monitor R-7762 during rollout.
rita: thanks team. closing thread once follow-ups are filed. :thumbsup:
